text:
Nina (CS): @Priya quick heads-up: Ventara wants a 5-day APAC pilot next week. Requests: add two CIDRs to allowlist for peering and raise soft QPS to 420. Can infra and network confirm feasibility?
Priya (Ventara): Pilot window 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-09. CIDRs: 192.0.2.32/28 and 198.51.100.0/25. Typical steady 200 qps, plan for 420 qps soft cap. Read-only dashboard access for ops@ventara.io please.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Sounds doable. Need exact edge region pin preference and whether auto-revoke is required. Also will add soft quota alerting.
Cam (Network): We have existing peering with their ASN but not those CIDRs. Auto-revoke after 5 days OK. Recommend pin to ap-southeast-1 / apac-edge-a to keep latency < 90ms.
Nina (CS): Auto-revoke=yes. Pin to apac-edge-a. I'll log a ticket CS-9142 for tracking and renewal note (renewal in 3 weeks).
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Draft patch (account-scoped, non-global):
```json
{ "account": "ventara", "edge_pool": "apac-edge-a", "allowlist": ["192.0.2.32/28","198.51.100.0/25"], "rate_limit": {"qps": 420, "type": "soft"}, "meta": {"pilot": "2026-04-05..2026-04-09", "auto_revoke_days": 5}}
```
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Deployment plan: 1) create acl tags ventara-pilot-0405, ttl=5d; 2) apply routing preference for ventara -> apac-edge-a; 3) create soft quota alert at 75% predicted usage; 4) schedule job 2026-04-04T23:00Z.
deploy-bot: queued change job job-99314 by Ravi; expected apply 2026-04-04T23:00:00Z.
Cam (Network): Add fallback policy: route to apac-edge-b when apac-edge-a utilization > 72% to prevent errors. Also set BGP community for preferred path.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Will add utilization fallback and KV cache warmup 12s on reroute. Rollback plan: remove acl tags and revert routing preference within 15m if error rate > 1% or latency > 250ms for 5m window. I'll post telemetry after 24h and a short summary at pilot end.
Priya (Ventara): Ops invite please + sample prompts for quality checks. We'll also send a spike test on day 1.
Nina (CS): I'll send dashboard invite and include an enablement slot 2026-04-04 16:00 PT. Also adding renewal risk note to CS-9142 and a follow-up NPS request after pilot.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): CLI snippets for ops (ops-only):
```bash
redwood infra acl add --account ventara --cidr 192.0.2.32/28 --tag ventara-pilot-0405 --ttl 5d
redwood infra acl add --account ventara --cidr 198.51.100.0/25 --tag ventara-pilot-0405 --ttl 5d
redwood infra routing set --account ventara --edge-pool apac-edge-a --policy prefer
redwood infra rate update --account ventara --qps 420 --type soft
```
Cam (Network): Confirmed route adverts and BGP settings. One note: add monitoring to check path flaps during re-route.
Nina (CS): Follow-ups: 1) CS-9142 tracks allowlist, dashboard invite, renewal flag; 2) enablement 2026-04-04 16:00 PT; 3) Ravi to post rollout summary + telemetry in this thread.
Priya (Ventara): Thanks team 44d
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Will update thread when job starts and again after 24h of pilot.
Nina (CS): Closing loop for now. Tag #eng-oncall if anything spikes unexpectedly.
